content:
sylvia: quick heads-up: a customer reported raw request IDs showing up in DEBUG logs from the JS quickstart. looks tied to retry logic + otel initialization order. anyone run into this pattern? :mag:

jorge: yes. usually it's when the logger binds a formatter before the otel redaction hook is registered. the logger serializes structured fields and then scrubbers never get a chance to run.

kai: also watch out for header clones. our retry middleware used to copy headers and stash the original into a nonstandard key (`x-rw-reqid-raw`). redact hook only checks common names so clones leak.

sylvia: repro i got: start sampleapp in dev, set REDWOOD_REDACT=1, trigger a retry by returning 502 once. log line: ```DEBUG 2026-03-23 path=/v1/chat requestId=req_zz9f7a attempts=2```  requestId should be masked.

jorge: two straightforward mitigations: 1) run telemetry bootstrap synchronously at the very top of app startup (before any logger or middleware registration); 2) normalize headers during clone (lowercase keys) and run the redact hook on the cloned object.

kai: i prefer adding a defensive scrub in the logger formatter too: if a string field matches the reqid regex, replace with [REDACTED]. That catches weird keys and third-party middleware. cheap and effective.

telemetry-bot: FYI docs: https://playbook.redwood.ai/telemetry/startup-order and open task infra#1045 to add redwood.telemetry.bootstrap() helper to SDK.

jorge: sylvia, can you open a tiny PR on sampleapp to: move require('./telemetry/bootstrap') to index.js top, run normalize+redact in retry clone, and add unit test that simulates a retry and asserts logs contain "[REDACTED]"?

sylvia: working on it. i also added a note to quickstart about the perf tradeoff for cold-starts when telemetry runs sync. wording: "Run telemetry.bootstrap() early; this installs scrubbers and OTEL hooks required for safe debug logs. In dev this is fine; prod servers can lazy-init if you control logger order."

kai: add the logger-level scrub as a fallback and make it opt-out via env var (REDWOOD_LOGGER_SCRUB=false) so advanced users can skip. also include tests for node 18/20 and ts/js.

jorge: agree. once merged, let's backport a small migration note in the SDK changelog so customers searching for raw reqid incidents find the fix quickly.

telemetry-bot: build CI triggered: sampleapp/pr-1123. linux/amd64 green, mac flake on integration timeout.

kai: flake unrelated. sylvia, merge when green-ish. thanks for catching this early.

sylvia: PR merged, validated on node18. debug logs masked now. will follow up with SDK helper RFC for a synchronous bootstrap API. closing when changelog blurb is live. :white_check_mark:
